title: No destination yet: no pushing for one, and the plan still locks
origin: Issue #76 (destination, path and today's step): "Not sure yet" is fine

answers.what: Atomic Habits, I have it on my nightstand

history.text: 20 min is about all I've got before I fall asleep lol
Twenty it is. Do you track your reading anywhere, like Goodreads or a notes app?

testerLines: nope, no app. and no idea what I'm aiming for yet tbh, I just want to read more
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the destination is optional and must never get in the way of locking.
shouldHaveHappened: The tester already said they don't know what they're aiming for, so ZOH doesn't ask about a destination again (at most one light mention that they can add one later is fine) and goes on to the plan: day 1's step fully defined (tonight at 9 pm in bed, Atomic Habits, a clear amount such as 20 minutes or a number of pages), the usual schedule, a proof that works without an app (a photo of the page or a short voice note), a line on how it goes from here, no list of future steps, one question. After "looks good" it asks for the commitment naturally; after "I'm in" it locks with no destination and no friction.
